$comment: GENERATED by scripts/careers/build_production_careers.cjs from the approved career review data. Do not edit by hand. Contains only reviewed information; no research scores.

provenance.source: Approved Career Direction catalogue, reviewed OSCA relationships and Career -> Capability -> MBA evidence model (data/careers/review/)

policy.bands: strong / relevant / worth-exploring, from the approved research bands (strong >= 60, relevant >= 40, supporting >= 20). Numbers are never exported.
policy.exploreMode: Shown as "MBAs worth exploring" (no ranking language) when no connection is relevant or strong, when any of weak-overall-connection, draft-evidence-needed, many-similar-mbas, no-osca-weak-grounding is flagged, or when the career relies mainly on shared experiences without a specialist domain MBA.
policy.osca: Only approved official relationships and occupations marked related-for-exploration or exploration-only are included.
policy.overview: Careers without a primary official occupation use curated Career Direction text (capability rationales), never attributed to OSCA.

capabilities.label: Strategic Leadership
capabilities.definition: Ability to set direction, make accountable decisions and lead an organisation or function towards long-term goals.

capabilities.label: People Leadership
capabilities.definition: Ability to lead, motivate and develop individuals and teams, and to build effective working relationships within them.

capabilities.label: Strategic Thinking
capabilities.definition: Ability to analyse organisational environments, evaluate alternatives and develop coherent strategic responses.

capabilities.label: Organisational Transformation
capabilities.definition: Ability to design, lead and embed significant change in how an organisation is structured, operates or creates value.

capabilities.label: Innovation & Opportunity Development
capabilities.definition: Ability to identify opportunities and develop, test and grow new ideas, products, services or ventures.

capabilities.label: Business Analysis
capabilities.definition: Ability to investigate business problems, processes and requirements and to recommend practical, evidence-based improvements.

capabilities.label: Data Analysis
capabilities.definition: Ability to collect, prepare and analyse data with appropriate tools and methods to produce reliable findings.

capabilities.label: Data-informed Decision-making
capabilities.definition: Ability to interpret evidence and use data to improve organisational decision-making.

capabilities.label: AI & Digital Capability
capabilities.definition: Ability to understand, apply and lead the use of artificial intelligence and digital technologies in organisations.

capabilities.label: Business Intelligence
capabilities.definition: Ability to turn organisational data into accessible insight, reporting and monitoring that supports management.

capabilities.label: Financial Decision-making
capabilities.definition: Ability to use financial information to evaluate options, allocate resources and make sound business and investment decisions.

capabilities.label: Customer & Market Strategy
capabilities.definition: Ability to understand customers and markets and to develop strategies that create and capture value for them.

capabilities.label: Commercial Thinking
capabilities.definition: Ability to recognise how value, revenue, cost and competition shape organisational performance and decisions.

capabilities.label: Stakeholder Engagement
capabilities.definition: Ability to understand, engage and work effectively with organisational, industry, community or professional stakeholders.

capabilities.label: Communication & Influence
capabilities.definition: Ability to communicate clearly with different audiences and to build support for ideas, decisions and change.

capabilities.label: Workforce & Organisational Capability
capabilities.definition: Ability to plan, build and develop the workforce, skills and organisational capability needed to achieve organisational goals.

capabilities.label: Impact & Responsible Leadership
capabilities.definition: Ability to consider social, ethical and broader organisational impacts when leading and making decisions.

capabilities.label: Systems & Operational Thinking
capabilities.definition: Ability to understand how processes, resources and systems interact and to plan, run and improve operations.

strategic-leadership.text: Provides exposure to leadership perspectives through an alumni mentor.

strategic-thinking.text: Supports development of strategic choices in a simulated business (BUSN9148).
Provides opportunities to test decisions and try different approaches.

innovation.text: Provides opportunities to explore where technology and business meet (BUSN9128 option).

data-driven-decisions.text: Provides opportunities to use results to adjust decisions (BUSN9148).

ai-digital-capability.text: Supports development of understanding of technology in industry (BUSN9128 option).

customer-market-strategy.text: Supports development of market decision-making in a simulated business (BUSN9148).

commercial-thinking.text: Supports development of commercial awareness in a working organisation.
Provides opportunities to practise business decisions and see their consequences (BUSN9148).

stakeholder-engagement.text: Provides opportunities to practise working with workplace and industry stakeholders.

communication-influence.text: Provides opportunities to practise professional communication in a workplace.
Provides opportunities to practise professional conversations with an experienced mentor.

systems-operational-thinking.text: Provides opportunities to observe how organisational processes and people work together.
Provides opportunities to explore advanced manufacturing operations (BUSN9128 option).
